Long preview snippets truncate and command input has only placeholder guidance.

top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts reserve too much width for the sidebar and truncate identities.
top_issues.evidence: At 760x640 the rail and sidebar end at x=296, 39% of the window. Chat names include Katherine Jo... and Margaret Hamil...; the content pane has only 464 px.
top_issues.fix: Below 900 px, make the list collapsible with a labelled Back to chats/Teams control; use a 200 pt list plus the 64 pt rail when both panes are shown. Preserve full names before preview text.

top_issues.issue: Video calling loses its visible entry point at narrow width.
top_issues.evidence: Wide Calls has audio at x=295 and video at x=333. At 760 px only the audio icon near x=265 remains; there is no visible overflow menu.
top_issues.fix: Keep both 24 pt icon targets with 8 pt separation, or add a 32 pt overflow button with labelled Audio call and Video call choices.

top_issues.issue: Attachment thumbnails conceal the contents of extreme aspect-ratio images.
top_issues.evidence: 3072x256 and 256x3072 attachments both occupy roughly 144x96 px tiles at x=393,545,697 and y=600-696. The tall attachment shows only fragments.
top_issues.fix: Fit the entire bitmap within a 144x96 pt tile using contain, with a neutral #EEEFF2 light / #2C2D33 dark backing. Keep a 12 pt dimensions label and a 24 pt remove target.

top_issues.issue: Long draft overflow has no visible position cue.
top_issues.evidence: Editor spans x=380-1264, y=553-761. It shows SELECT column_111 through column_119 with no visible scrollbar inside the editor, although the content clearly starts earlier.
top_issues.fix: Add a persistent 6 pt internal scroll thumb with 4 pt inset while content overflows. Add a 24 pt expand-editor action beside attachment/send controls; retain the approximately 200 pt default cap.

top_issues.issue: Search highlight and committed recipients are easy to confuse.
top_issues.evidence: Grace Hopper is the chip at y=173, Barbara Liskov has a filled row at y=269-313, but the primary action still reads Chat with Grace Hopper. This can be keyboard highlight rather than selection, but the appearance is ambiguous.
top_issues.fix: Add a visible + Add action at the trailing edge of each candidate row and a checkmark only for committed recipients. Label the bottom action Start chat (1 person), using 13 pt text.

top_issues.issue: Hover action bars give many small actions equal visual weight.
top_issues.evidence: Group-chat toolbar occupies approximately x=955-1252, y=412-450 with six reactions plus reply/edit/delete/copy. Narrow chat packs actions into x=519-732. The pointer-induced hover itself is expected.
top_issues.fix: Show Reply, one reaction picker and More as three 28 pt targets with 4 pt gaps. Put copy/edit/delete behind More; retain 8 pt offset from author metadata.

top_issues.issue: Meeting details bury the actual schedule below organiser-oriented metadata.
top_issues.evidence: The card at x=388-1028, y=98-309 lists Organizer, Location, Online, Starts in 24 min. Absolute times appear only as 12 pt text in the header at y=34; no absolute date is present in the detail body.
top_issues.fix: Place Today, 15 November · 12:52-13:37 as a 15 pt first row and Starts in 24 min below it at 13 pt. Group organiser/location beneath with 16 pt separation.

top_issues.issue: Settings mixes dense explanatory prose with controls and ambiguous bottom-edge fading.
top_issues.evidence: The 560 px dialog shows a three-line paragraph at y=433-475 between checkboxes. Move Wren beside the call window is faded at y=713, coinciding with the scroll viewport edge.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 pt helper text immediately beneath the related checkbox with 6 pt gap, move relay detail behind a Learn more disclosure, and reserve 16 pt bottom padding beyond the last fully visible row. Explain disabled settings explicitly instead of relying on a fade.

top_issues.issue: Available and busy presence often rely on colour alone.
top_issues.evidence: List avatars use a plain green dot for Ada and a plain red dot for Grace; DND and away already have internal glyphs. The Account menu supplies text, but the repeated sidebar dots do not.
top_issues.fix: Use 10 pt presence markers with a check for Available and a horizontal bar for Busy, preserving current colour and a 2 pt backing ring. Keep the full text labels in the account menu.

top_issues.issue: Reading width is excessive for long message paragraphs.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280 px body text can run from x=432 toward x=1260. At 1920 px the bounded conversation starts near x=680 after a 316 px gutter from the sidebar, and body text still spans very long lines.
top_issues.fix: Cap message body text at 720 pt, leaving action controls in a separate trailing area. At wide size reduce the left conversation gutter to 48-96 pt and align header, message avatars and composer to the same content column.

top_issues.issue: First-run configuration presents several technical prerequisites at once.
top_issues.evidence: Card x=405-875, y=222-648 combines registration prose, guide button, GUID field, tenant guidance, save explanation and WREN_CLIENT_ID/WREN_TENANT environment variable text.
top_issues.fix: Use three numbered 14 pt steps: Create registration, Paste application ID, Choose tenant. Keep 16 pt between steps; move environment-variable setup behind a 13 pt Advanced disclosure.

top_issues.issue: Small metadata and symbols require precise reading and pointer placement.
top_issues.evidence: Timestamps and composer helper text are approximately 12 pt; rail labels about 11 pt. The attachment chip remove mark is about 8 px, and image remove buttons about 22 px.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 pt for metadata and navigation labels; use at least 24x24 pt remove targets even when glyphs are 12 pt. Preserve 4-8 pt spacing around small controls.

top_issues.issue: Selected timestamps pass contrast with very little safety margin.
top_issues.evidence: Pillow samples at chats x=313-346,y=246-261 give #62656D on #E4E4E8 = 4.598:1 light and #9C9EA8 on #34353C = 4.574:1 dark. These pass 4.5:1; antialiased edge pixels were not treated as separate text colours.
top_issues.fix: For selected-row metadata use #555861 in light and #B4B6BF in dark, keeping current backgrounds; increase timestamp type to 13 pt. Do not reduce opacity on these labels.

top_issues.issue: Authentication fallback tooltip is excessively wide.
top_issues.evidence: Tooltip begins around x=609 and ends x=1119 while the card ends x=875; it stays on one line below Use a code instead. This is a legitimate hover state, not a stray permanent element.
top_issues.fix: Wrap tooltip to 300 pt maximum width with 12 pt padding and 13 pt text, aligned below its trigger. Keep 8 pt distance from the trigger.

top_issues.issue: Fit mode gives no numerical scale or attachment identity.
top_issues.evidence: Toolbar shows Fit, 100% and 3072x256 at y=77-105. The image is fitted into approximately 928 px width, but the resulting roughly 30% scale is not displayed and no filename is shown.
top_issues.fix: Show Fit (30%) alongside 100% using 13 pt text; add a single-line filename under the title and keep dimensions secondary at 12 pt.

top_issues.issue: Shortcut dialog sits too close to the lower window edge.
top_issues.evidence: Dialog spans y=90-788 in an 800 px window, leaving only 12 px below and 90 px above.
top_issues.fix: Cap the dialog at window height minus 48 pt, centre it vertically, and use an internal scrolling body with 24 pt exterior clearance.
